gloss: turning off the lights; lights out

definitions.gloss: turning off the lights; lights out
definitions.explanation: The act of switching off lights, or the designated time when lights are turned off, especially in institutional settings like dormitories, hospitals, or camps.

examples.japanese: {消灯|しょうとう}{時間|じかん}は{十時|じゅうじ}です。
examples.english: Lights out is at ten o'clock.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}では{九時|くじ}に{消灯|しょうとう}になる。
examples.english: In the hospital, lights go out at nine.

examples.japanese: {消灯|しょうとう}{後|ご}も{布団|ふとん}の{中|なか}でこっそり{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいた。
examples.english: Even after lights out, I was secretly reading a book under the covers.

notes: Composed of {消|しょう} (extinguish) + {灯|とう} (light, lamp). The opposite is {点灯|てんとう} (turning on the lights). Most commonly used in institutional contexts — {消灯|しょうとう}{時間|じかん} (lights-out time) is a standard phrase in hospitals, dormitories, military barracks, and summer camps. In everyday home use, {電気|でんき}を{消|け}す (turn off the light) is more natural.
